featured_reviews.review_text:
The trainers on the Cult Transform program are genuinely excellent — knowledgeable, supportive, and worth showing up for. This review is not about them.
My issue is with the front-desk staff member who handles late arrivals.
I have a demanding schedule, and I consistently make the effort to show up, even when it would be easier not to. On one occasion, I arrived a minute past the 5-minute cutoff, still putting on my shoes. I was told I should have scanned the QR code before wearing my shoes. I understand there's a policy. I don't understand why it needs to be enforced with zero discretion, in full view of an entire class, rather than stepped aside and handled quietly.
This isn't an isolated incident. This staff member has spoken to me rudely on multiple occasions, told me I "lack discipline," and instructed me to email Cult if I can't arrive on time. All for a one-minute delay from someone who keeps coming back despite a packed schedule.
The 5-minute rule exists. Discipline matters. But so does basic courtesy, privacy when raising an issue, and some recognition that a person showing up late is still a person who showed up.
A program this good deserves front-of-house staff who represent it the same way.
